content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] [article_no] connected to an HMI panel ([product_name]). It works well! How can I set the correct time and date on the HMI panel? I know how to display the time and date from the [product_name] on the HMI, but the HMI’s own clock isn’t accurate (it shows the year as 2004). How can I set and use the correct time and date directly on the HMI? I'm using [product_name] in [product_name] [version_no].

Hello [user_name], I'm not sure if my attachment is exactly what you need, but it covers the VM range for [product_name] [article_no]. On page 112, it discusses the real-time clock availability in the VM range. Unfortunately, the documentation is only available in German.

Yes, I’m familiar with the VM addresses for the RTC in the [product_name]. I can display those values on the HMI, and I can also adjust the [product_name] clock using the keys I set up on the HMI. However, the HMI unit itself also has an internal clock (date and time). How can I set this internal HMI clock to the current time (like the one in the [product_name])?
Are you looking to synchronize the time and date from the [product_name] to the HMI settings?
No, I want to set the internal clock and date in the HMI panel directly. The HMI has its own clock, which does not match the actual date and time. How can I adjust this time?
I hope this information will help you.
Thanks, so it seems it’s not possible to set the time on the HMI panel manually. That’s the functionality I was searching for.

You can adjust the Time and Date properties for the [product_name] by accessing screen management, then opening the template. Change the Date and Time properties to Input/Output to enable adjustment. Cheers!

Hi, Most users of [product_name] may not have much experience with HMI panels. If you can’t resolve it here, it might be useful to repost your question in the dedicated HMI forum. They could offer more specific assistance. Regards
In my view, this topic is resolved. The original question was posted about a year ago, and the user [user_name] has just brought it up again.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having difficulty independently configuring the internal clock of HMI panels, even though linking and displaying time data from the [product_name] module is straightforward. The challenge lies in finding clear instructions or settings to directly adjust or synchronize the HMI’s internal time, which sometimes displays incorrect values. Documentation appears limited, leading to uncertainty and user experimentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to be able to directly set or adjust the HMI panel’s built-in date and time separately from the [product_name] module’s clock.
